section_summary.extract_value: This introduction reviews the Big Five personality domains and their associations with body image, particularly focusing on gender differences. The authors note that while Neuroticism has been extensively studied in relation to women's body image, research on men's body image—particularly drive for muscularity and body appreciation—in relation to the Big Five traits remains limited. The present study aims to examine associations between the Big Five domains, men's drive for muscularity, and body appreciation, predicting that Neuroticism will be positively associated with drive for muscularity and negatively associated with body appreciation.
